$comment: Declarative Appwrite project operations for the reviewed TEST project. Functions themselves are declared in appwrite/appwrite.config.json (Appwrite CLI format); this file holds what the CLI cannot push with a project API key: auth methods/policies, platforms, per-function variables, function domains and the scheduled-job plan. Applied by `pnpm appwrite:apply`, drift-checked by `pnpm appwrite:check-live`. Never put a secret value in this file: secret variables are generated server-side at apply time and stored only as secret function variables.

auth.$comment: SRS FR-AUTH-001..005 + docs/api/AUTH.md. Email/password is the baseline; JWT must stay on (every service verifies Account.get with the user JWT). Guest is a bundled local demo (FR-ONB-002, AUTH.md), so anonymous sessions stay off. Magic URL, email OTP and phone are not in the SRS and the test project has no SMTP/SMS provider. Team invites stay on for the maintainer content-publish team. OAuth providers (FR-AUTH-003) are configured only with real provider credentials (none yet).

buckets.$comment: Buckets are declared in appwrite/schema/foundation.json and applied by `pnpm schema:apply` (learning-assets). Nothing extra here: private AI recordings stay unbuilt until the AI adapter exists.

messaging.$comment: FR-NOTIFY-001 uses local OS reminders first; APNS/FCM are not required. No Messaging provider or topic is configured; check-live asserts none exist.

schedules.purpose: Learning dispatcher drains due l_outbox rows (bounded batch <= 20) and delivers signed events to Progress (CONSISTENCY, ARCHITECTURE 'Scheduled bounded drain'). Worker mode shipped (services/learning/src/index.ts, x-appwrite-trigger=schedule at '/'); stays pending until Learning persistence is enabled on this project (the worker answers 503 SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED while disabled).

Progress worker (services/progress/src/http/worker.ts, x-appwrite-trigger=schedule at '/'): every minute outbox relay (account.deleted/entitlement.changed/energy.granted -> Learning/AI) and deletion purge retry; minute 5 hourly streak day rollover (missed-day freeze / streak reset; every zone's midnight falls in some UTC hour); minute 15 hourly league settlement (last ended week Monday 00:00 UTC + any SETTLING week, closes only at a zero Learning watermark, retried hourly up to the 24h intervention flag). One function schedule because a function carries one cron; the same jobs are signed /internal/jobs/* routes for a scheduler/maintainer key.

$schedulesNote: A function has a single cron and Appwrite invokes it at path '/' with x-appwrite-trigger: schedule. No hosted entrypoint implements a worker mode yet, and ARCHITECTURE requires worker mode to be selected only by verified platform schedule context. Until a service ships that worker, the live function schedule stays empty (check-live enforces it) so the cron cannot burn executions on 401s. To activate: implement the worker in the service, set status to 'active' (one active schedule per function; the progress jobs share one hourly cron and dispatch by time), then `pnpm appwrite:apply`.
